House '''Chiendelna''' was a minor Murandian noble house.{{ref/book|twotc|Chiendelna}} [[Slayer|"Lord Luc"]]{{ref/book|twotc|Luc}}{{ref/book|twotc|Slayer}} claimed membership in this relatively old but minor house during his time in the [[Two Rivers]]. [[Verin Mathwin|Verin Sedai]] thought the word had a Borderlander sound, so it is unclear if the house even really still exists at all.
